items.title: Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic back one AI training opt-out
items.summary:
Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic will honour one shared AI training opt-out in robots.txt. It lets a website keep its content out of generative AI training with a single rule. Today, a site that wants to say no has to write separate rules for each company’s crawler. The shared signal comes from an IETF draft […]

items.title: How the Most AI-Pilled Company in the World Works
items.summary: A 10-person gaming startup called Spawn spends 30 times more on tokens than payroll and has an agent fleet shipping 77,000 code changes a month. Its founder's two-year playbook is a field guide to what AI-native actually means, and why most companies will find it hard to copy. In the headlines: an AI startup bids for a bankrupt white-shoe law firm, and tech earnings expose a widening rift between hyperscalers and investors.

items.title: Trump declares robot imports a national security threat
items.summary:
US President Donald Trump has ordered trade talks on robot imports. A Commerce Department investigation found that foreign-made robots and industrial machinery threaten national security. He signed the proclamation on Wednesday 28 October. It sets no tariffs for now. The proclamation uses Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. The law lets the […]
